ReleaseNotes: Added the Lineman role and dedicated Lineman module with Site Lookup, My Tasks, and History.
Added a restricted Lineman Site Dashboard with Main, Site History, and PingScreen access, including PingScreen support for MR sites.
Added full Lineman assignment support across Dispatch Tickets, Truck Board, Daily Assignments, field tasks, history, and crew workflows.
Added Administration Connected Clients monitoring with client heartbeat tracking, logged-in user, computer, active module, application version, online state, and outdated-version detection.
Added theme-aware Online, Offline, Current, and Outdated status badges across all supported application themes.
Updated Dispatch Tasks to show only the latest technician write-up submission for a ticket instead of combining all previous write-ups together.
Fixed follow-up work so a new technician submission gets its own fresh Dispatch closeout checklist, without carrying over completion state from an earlier submission.
Preserved prior write-up/checklist history while keeping each submission independent.
Updated Edit Ticket to show the complete technician write-up history in chronological order.
Added a clear 40-hyphen divider between individual technician write-up submissions in Edit Ticket.
Added a dedicated write-up history API so Edit Ticket uses the actual submission records instead of relying on the accumulated ticket Notes field.
Made technician write-up history consistent when opening Edit Ticket from the Tickets pane, Tasks Pane, Daily Assignments.
